The apprentice's eyes widened as they spotted a small, leather-bound tome nestled in the corner of the attic. It seemed to glow faintly with an otherworldly light, and the air around it shimmered with magic. The book was clearly old, its pages yellowed and fragile, but there was something irresistibly alluring about it.

The apprentice reached out tentatively, their fingers brushing against the worn leather cover. A sudden rush of power surged through them as they made contact with the book - a mix of fear and excitement coursing through their veins. They knew this was something forbidden; their mentor had expressly warned them not to touch anything in this part of the tower without permission.

But curiosity got the better of them, and before they could stop themselves, they'd snatched up the tome and hidden it beneath their robes. The apprentice felt a strange sense of satisfaction at their defiance - but also an underlying dread that they might be discovered...
